title: Plant-based meats are coming soon to a dinner table near you…

sents.en: Plant-based meats are coming soon to a dinner table near you, but do they deserve a spot on your plate?
sents.cn: 植物基肉类即将出现在你附近的餐桌上，但它们值得在你的盘子里占一席之地吗？如果你多年前试过蔬菜汉堡，并因其又硬又没味而弃之不顾，那么现在是给无肉之肉又一次机会的好时机。

sents.en: If you tried a vegetable burger years ago and dismissed it as rubbery and flavorless, it·s a good time to give meatless meat another chance.
sents.cn: 较新的品种模仿了肉的外观、风味和质地。

sents.en: Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat.
sents.cn: 分析人士预计这场无肉运动短期内不会放缓；

sents.en: Analysts don·t expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030 · a 957 percent surge.
sents.cn: 一份2021年的报告预测，到2030年该市场将飙升至740亿美元——增幅达957%。

sents.en: Plant-based meats are no longer just for vegetarians.
sents.cn: 植物基肉类不再只是素食者的专属。

sents.en: Companies such as Impossible Foods and Beyond Meat · the current superstars of the alternative protein sector · are pursuing consumers who enjoy meat but want to reduce their meat consumption for animal rights, health, or environmental reasons.
sents.cn: 诸如ImpossibleFoods和BeyondMeat——替代蛋白领域当前的超级明星——等公司，正瞄准那些爱吃肉、却出于动物权利、健康或环境原因想要减少肉类消费的人群。

sents.en: So far, it·s a winning strategy: More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat.
sents.cn: 迄今为止，这是一项制胜策略：购买BeyondBurger和ImpossibleFoods产品的消费者中，超过九成也吃肉。

sents.en: Many vegetarians don·t actually care for food that resembles meat.
sents.cn: 许多素食者其实并不喜欢形似肉的食物。

sents.en: When reporter Joan Solsman, a longtime vegetarian, tried a dish from Impossible Foods, she felt so sick that she couldn·t finish it.
sents.cn: 当资深素食者、记者琼∙索尔斯曼试吃ImpossibleFoods的一道菜时，她感到如此恶心，以至于无法吃完。

sents.en: ·Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn·t stand to take another bite,· she wrote.
sents.cn: “或许ImpossibleFoods已破解逼真假肉密码的最佳证据，就是我一口也受不了再吃下去，”她写道。

sents.en: Meatless meats are generally a healthier choice than beef because they are cholesterol-free, plus they're a good source of vitamins, minerals, protein, and fiber.
sents.cn: 无肉肉类通常是比牛肉更健康的选择，因为它们不含胆固醇，而且是维生素、矿物质、蛋白质和纤维的良好来源。

sents.en: If meatless meat can help you stick to a plant-based diet, that in itself can lead to better health.
sents.cn: 如果无肉肉类能帮你坚持植物基饮食，这本身就能带来更好的健康。

sents.en: Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels.
sents.cn: 红肉不仅与癌症相关，研究还显示，戒肉的人血压更低、平均血糖更低、胆固醇水平也更低。

sents.en: However, just because it·s plant-based doesn·t mean it·s health food.
sents.cn: 然而，仅仅因为它是植物基的，并不意味着它就是健康食品。

sents.en: Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium (钠) compared to traditional beef.
sents.cn: 与传统的牛肉相比，大多数仿肉制品经过了高度加工，并含有大量钠（钠）。

sents.en: These new generations of alternate meat get all the attention, but don·t forget about whole grains and vegetables.
sents.cn: 这些新一代替代肉类吸引了所有目光，但别忘了全谷物和蔬菜。

sents.en: Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute.
sents.cn: 豆类是一种特别优秀的蛋白质替代品。

sents.en: They· re nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
sents.cn: 它们营养丰富、价格低廉，并且比当今市场上任何经过加工的无肉替代品都更具可持续性。
